create_ema_wrapper: create an EMA wrapper around a PyTorch model with a configurable decay rate
update_ema_shadow_params: update the EMA shadow parameters by calling update_ema after each training step
copy_ema_to_model: copy the EMA shadow parameters back into the original model weights
backup_and_restore_model: backup original model parameters and restore them when switching between train and eval modes
use_ema_for_inference: use the EMA wrapped model for inference by calling forward with input tensors
